idea-plugin.name: Docstring Freshness Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
Docstring Freshness Monitor — Keep Your Documentation as Fresh as Your Code

Detect stale documentation automatically using git history analysis. Every docstring gets a freshness score (0-100) so you know which docs are trustworthy and which are outdated.

Features

  • Freshness Scoring — 0-100 score per doc block from the commits that touched the code below it since the doc last changed
  • Stale Doc Inspection — stale blocks as warnings, rotten blocks as errors; also via Analyze → Inspect Code
  • Multi-Language — Javadoc/KDoc, Python docstrings, JSDoc and # comment blocks
  • Doc Freshness Tool Window — per-block scores for the current file
  • Configurable Thresholds — fresh / aging / stale / rotten score boundaries

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2+ or another IntelliJ-based IDE
  • Git plugin and a Git repository with history

Support

Documentation | Issue Tracker | Contact Support
